endorsements.quote: Establish an AI governance council before any AI models are deployed.

An organization approving AI platform procurement without first conducting a dimension-level DT-Debt assessment and assigning itself to an archetype is committing investment without a readiness baseline.
Proceed with phased enterprise AI rollout sequenced by dimensionlevel debt.
Run shadow-mode AI validation in parallel with existing workflows before any system assumes operational authority.

unlisted_practices: Conduct a dimension-by-dimension organizational digital transformation debt assessment before committing AI investment.
Defer clinical and operational AI deployment until Data Debt and Governance Debt are reduced to moderate levels.
Do not approve AI platform procurement without a parallel debt reduction plan.
Establish real-time AI model performance monitoring infrastructure with defined response protocols for degradation before AI assumes operational authority at scale.
Invest in role-specific workforce upskilling with behavioral validation rather than module completion tracking.
Sequence AI deployment by dimension-level debt, starting in the lowest-debt areas.
Implement clinician codesign processes to align model outputs with workflow requirements.

screen.reason: The paper introduces a conceptual framework (Digital Transformation Debt framework) to assess organizational readiness and governance for healthcare AI implementation, using synthetic profiles to illustrate the framework.
